notes.Nikola Jokic: Denver plays at Chicago in the highest-total game on the slate (237.5), and Chicago is without Caleb Wilson with Norman Powell (hamstring) and Jalen Smith (illness) questionable. Jokic has played 37 to 39 minutes in each of his last five games, and Julian Strawther (knee) is still out for Denver.
notes.Jamal Murray: Murray has been in the 35-to-38-minute range in four of his last five games and gets the slate's highest total at Chicago, which is missing Caleb Wilson. Friday was a quiet night for him, but his role as Denver's second creator has not changed.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: Towns missed Saturday's one-point win over Portland with an illness, and New York had not filed today's injury report this morning, so his status for the second night of the back-to-back is not posted. Andre Drummond started at center Saturday and James Wiseman played 25 minutes behind him; OG Anunoby (calf) and Jordan Clarkson (foot) are also day-to-day.
notes.Jalen Brunson: With Karl-Anthony Towns sick and OG Anunoby out Saturday, Brunson carried New York early with 19 points in the first quarter and played 36 minutes. Towns, Anunoby and Jordan Clarkson are all day-to-day and the Knicks have not filed today's report; Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton and T.J. McConnell.
notes.Jayson Tatum: Tatum sat Saturday at Sacramento for rest on the first night of the back-to-back and was expected back Sunday at Golden State, but Boston had not filed today's injury report this morning, so his status is not posted. Golden State is without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Brandon Williams.
notes.Cooper Flagg: Flagg played 36 minutes Saturday with P.J. Washington out sick, and Dallas is on the second night of a back-to-back at Utah; the Mavericks had not filed today's report this morning, so Washington's status is not posted. Utah is without Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic.
notes.Kyrie Irving: Irving played 35 minutes Saturday and scored 12 in the fourth quarter after a 1-for-7 start, and Dallas is on the second night of a back-to-back at a short-handed Utah team. The Mavericks have not posted today's injury report.
notes.Jarace Walker: Tyrese Haliburton and T.J. McConnell are both out with hamstring injuries and Pascal Siakam is questionable with hip soreness, which opens frontcourt and bench minutes. Walker played only 11 minutes Friday while McConnell still played, so his role depends on Siakam's status.
notes.Jay Huff: Huff fell to one minute on Friday behind Ivica Zubac, so his minutes swing a lot. He is a value only if Indiana goes deeper with Tyrese Haliburton and T.J. McConnell out and Pascal Siakam questionable.
notes.Obi Toppin: Toppin jumped to 26 minutes on Friday after 14 to 17 in his previous four games, and Pascal Siakam is questionable tonight with hip soreness. If Siakam sits, Toppin is the most likely forward to absorb those minutes.
notes.Pascal Siakam: Siakam is questionable at New York with hip soreness, and Indiana is already without Tyrese Haliburton and T.J. McConnell. He played 30 minutes Friday.
notes.Will Richard: Golden State is without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Brandon Williams, and Richard has played 27 minutes off the bench in each of the last two games. Draymond Green missed Thursday with an elbow injury but is not on today's report, which could trim the wing minutes.
notes.L.J. Cryer: Cryer started on November 16 and 18 with Stephen Curry and Brandon Williams out, but he went back to the bench for 12 minutes Thursday while Gary Payton II played 24. Both guards are still out, so the minutes are there, but Golden State's rotation has changed almost nightly.
notes.Jase Richardson: Richardson has not played since November 11 and missed Orlando's last four games, though he is not on today's injury report. Paolo Banchero remains out with his ankle injury, and Anthony Black has played 33 to 39 minutes in each of his last five games while Richardson has been away.
Clayton played through a questionable knee tag Saturday for 25 minutes as Kyrie Irving's backup, but Max Christie was the guard on the floor at the finish. Dallas is on the second night of a back-to-back and P.J. Washington's status is not posted yet.
notes.Max Christie: Christie played 24 minutes Saturday with P.J. Washington out sick, up from 8 in his first game back from an ankle sprain, and he closed the win. If Washington sits again on the back-to-back, the extra wing minutes are there for him again.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: Coulibaly has played 21 to 29 minutes off the bench in four of his last five games, and Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Reece Beekman on the wing. His value comes from steals and blocks rather than scoring.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Gilgeous-Alexander is questionable at Miami with a low back contusion and a neck strain, though he has played every game this season. Oklahoma City is without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace and Nikola Topic, so he scored 40 Friday in 37 minutes with almost no help.
notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: Antetokounmpo is questionable against Oklahoma City with right groin tendinitis after being limited in Saturday's practice. He has played 29 to 32 minutes in each of his last five games.
notes.Cade Cunningham: Cunningham is probable at Atlanta with right knee soreness after missing Wednesday and playing 36 minutes Friday. Detroit is without Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson, so more of the offense runs through him.
notes.Paul Reed: Jalen Duren is out with a hamstring strain, and Reed has been the main center off the bench, playing 20 to 28 minutes in his last four games. Atlanta is thin up front too, with Jock Landale, Mouhamed Gueye, Asa Newell and Henri Veesaar all out.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: Jenkins has started and played 35 to 42 minutes in each of his last five games, and Detroit is again without Duncan Robinson and Jalen Duren. Cade Cunningham is probable, which keeps Jenkins in a secondary ball-handling role.
notes.Tre Jones: Jones has played 23 to 25 minutes in three of Chicago's last four games off the bench, and Norman Powell is questionable with a hamstring strain. If Powell sits, more guard minutes go to Jones.
notes.Norman Powell: Powell is questionable against Denver with a right hamstring strain. He has carried a big scoring load since Caleb Wilson went out, but his production has dipped in his last two games.
notes.Payton Pritchard: Pritchard started Saturday with Jayson Tatum resting and Derrick White out, but Tatum was expected back and White could return Sunday, which would push him back to the bench. Boston has not filed today's report.
notes.Landry Shamet: Shamet started and played 36 minutes Saturday with Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby out, and he has closed New York's last several games. His minutes depend on whether Towns and Anunoby play, and the Knicks have not filed today's report.
notes.Andre Drummond: Drummond started at center Saturday with Karl-Anthony Towns out sick and played 23 minutes, including the finish. If Towns sits again, he and James Wiseman split the center minutes; New York has not posted today's report.
